items.title: Margin pressure, slower growth outlook may cap upside for Sun Pharma stock
items.description: Sun Pharma reported strong revenue and profit growth in the March quarter, but EBITDA margins faced pressure from increased investments and lower milestone income.  The company anticipates range-bound margins and moderating revenue growth in FY27, driven by specialty launches and R&D spending.  Domestic formulations remain robust, while US segment recovery is expected to be gradual.

items.title: Suzlon Energy Q4 Results: Profit falls 6% YoY to Rs 1,114 crore despite 45% revenue surge
items.description: Suzlon Energy Q4 Results: Revenue from operations, however, increased 45% YoY to Rs 5,468 crore.
